## Summary of the last run

The page is largely correct. The main genuine error is in Example 1 (Spec Z): the claim that closed sets are only finite sets of closed points plus the whole space is false, since every subset of the closed points is closed. The rest of the examples, the propositions, and the structure sheaf theorem appear sound.

## Issues

### ISSUE-0001 [Open] Spec Z closed sets are not only finite sets of closed points
- **Category:** Supplement/remark error
- **Location:** ag:spec-examples / item 1
- **Detail:** The example claims that the closed subsets of Spec Z are exactly the finite sets of closed points together with the whole space. This is false: for any subset S of primes, V((n)) where n is the product of primes in S (or V of the ideal generated by S) is closed, so every set of primes is closed (e.g. the set of all primes is V((0))... more precisely any subset of closed points is closed since Spec Z has the cofinite-type topology where every subset of the set of closed points is closed). Indeed for any set S of primes, the intersection of the localizations gives a closed set equal to S. So the closed sets are: the whole space, and arbitrary subsets of the set of closed points (i.e. any set of primes), not just finite ones.
- **Proposed fix:** Replace with: "閉集合は $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbb{Z}$ 全体、または閉点（素数）の任意の集合（有限に限らない）。実際、素数の集合 $S$ に対し $S=\bigcap_{p\in S}V((p))$ は閉である。"
- **Reported:** 2026-10-28 (8ccef3d)
